description_en: Copy an image to another region. If you want to share an image across regions, you can call this operation to copy the image to the destination region and then share the image
description_zh: 将镜像复制到另一地域。如需跨地域分享镜像，可以先调用本接口将镜像复制到新地域再进行分享
kebab_example: aliyun ecd copy-image --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-id m-gx2x1dhsmusr20000 --destination-image-name Office_Shanghai --destination-description This_is_a_test. --destination-region-id cn-shenzhen --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CopyImage

parameters.description_en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
parameters.description_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。

parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the image that is copied to the destination region.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the image that is copied to the destination region
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.description_en: The name of the new image. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. The name must start with a letter but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).
parameters.description_zh: 复制出来的新镜像的名称。长度为2\~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（\_）或者短划线（-）。
